units.source_text: 排寺不理世俗社会，按照样寺的老规矩开展活动。

en.t: The temple paid no attention to secular society and carried on its activities according to its old customs.

units.source_text: 因为是夏天，每天早晨最晚是五点起床。

en.t: Because it was summer, we got up every morning by five o'clock at the latest.
In the temple, getting up was called "opening meditation."

units.source_text: 起床后马上上早课诵经，称做"三时回向"，即读三回经。

en.t: Immediately after rising, we attended morning prayers and chanted sutras; this was called "threefold dedication," meaning that the sutra was read three times.
After that, we cleaned the rooms.
Then we had breakfast, which was called "the gruel seat."
Before eating, we had to chant the "Benza Sutra."
